items.summary: A JUDGMENT is a public document, written in the name of the Constitution and delivered in open court. The people may read it, praise it and criticise it, and the academy, bar, press and civil society should do so freely. Criticism is not the enemy of judicial authority; it is its source. A judiciary whose judgments are never read critically will never grow.
